signal: Lightbeam announced end-to-end AI information governance and usage control for Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, and Gemini in March 2026.

email.body1:
Mike, saw Lightbeam just launched AI governance for Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, and Gemini.

Landing a new category like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before quota catches up, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lightbeam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Lightbeam.

When you open a new product line, the number climbs faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lightbeam needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Lightbeam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lightbeam's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A security startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after launching a new category, I know the GTM stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a security GTM motion? I'll tailor it to Lightbeam either way.
